function.description: Technical analysis of ONE named DEX pool on any chain DexScreener covers (EVM and Solana), on closed candles only. Use when the user asks for technicals, indicators, RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger bands, ATR or a trend read for a pool. Pick the pool first with dexscreener__pairs_search or dexscreener__token_pairs_list: there is no tokenAddress here, so a pool is never chosen silently. Returns price, change, high and low over the bars asked for; EMA 20/50/200, RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger 20/2 and ATR 14 (the fixed set, no selection); six plain signals (price against EMA 20 and 50, EMA 20 against EMA 50, RSI zone at 70 and 30, MACD histogram sign, position against the bands); the last 10 closes with RSI and histogram; and `asOf`, the close time of the newest CLOSED candle used. The forming candle is never used, whatever the provider says about it. Prices are the provider's USD columns, read as numbers for analysis only; a bar whose USD high or low does not cover its own open and close is widened and counted in `closedCandles.normalized`, missing buckets are counted in `closedCandles.gaps` and never filled, and `sparse` is true when they exceed a tenth of the window. Reads 220 candles or bars + 60, whichever is more. Needs the desktop app's site bridge: without it the tool refuses with no_candle_source rather than answering empty. A reading is not a buy or sell signal. Read-only: no wallet, signing, order or approval path. Every response carries sourceObservation with the transport that answered, fetchedAtMs, and the cache state, so a cached catalog read is distinguishable from a live one.
function.name: dexscreener__technical_analysis_get

bars.description: How many closed candles the price facts cover, an integer from 30 to 200 (100 when omitted). The indicators always read the warm-up on top.

chain.description: Chain slug the pool lives on, for example solana, ethereum, bsc, base or robinhood. Chain slug/alias, or the numeric chain id `TokenFind` returns (e.g. `base` or `8453`). A pair or token address is only unique within one chain, so this is required; an unknown slug is refused by name with the nearest catalog matches rather than answered with zero rows.

interval.description: Candle size to analyse: 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h or 1d. Any other value is rejected.

pairAddress.description: The pool (pair) address, from dexscreener__pairs_search, dexscreener__token_pairs_list or a screening board. On EVM chains it must be the provider's CHECKSUM spelling, as those tools return it: the lowercased form is answered with zero rows. Solana addresses are passed verbatim.
